english.title: Sell / procure the sale of a prescribed medicinal product without authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in the course of business carried on by you

(A)_[sold]_
(B)_[procured the sale of]_

a relevant medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCT..), knowing or having reasonable cause to believe that the product was or was intended to be placed on the market without holding a Community or United Kingdom marketing authorisation for that product
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 2 and 14 of Schedule 3 to the Medicines for Human Use (Marketing Authorisations etc) Regulations 1994.

english.notes:
(i) This offence relates to prescribed drugs which are NOT CONTROLLED by the the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
(ii) See offence wording H3630 for possession of relevant medicinal product knowing etc that it was/intended for supply without relevant marketing authorisation.
(iii) The Medicines Control Agency (MCA) is responsible for the enforcement of medicines legislation in the United Kingdom. The MCA is an executive agency of the Department of Health whose primary objective is to safeguard public health by ensuring that all medicines on the UK market meet appropriate standards safety, quality and efficacy. The MCA have an intelligence unit:- telephone No 0207 2730617 and will assist with queries.
(iv) For the similar offences in relation to supply and manufacture see H8435 and H8436 respectively.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
